# `state/entity/SchemaRegistry.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/entity/SchemaRegistry.js`

state/entity/SchemaRegistry.js — meaning from schemas, not numeric tricks (spec rule 3). Every schema/validator/policy is versioned (spec rule 5) so migrations can reference exact stamps. A schema declares a name, a version, and a validate(value) predicate; validation is structural (legality), never a claim of semantic truth — that comes from commit logic.
